title: Diurnal Cortisol Slopes and Mental and Physical Health Outcomes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
meta_analysis_note: Systematic review + meta-analysis of 80 studies (179 associations). All effect sizes reported as r (correlation). Converted to Cohen's d via d=2r/√(1-r²). Random effects model. I²=83.23% overall. Egger test p=.002 but trim-and-fill found 0 missing studies. Cross-sectional=91.1% of findings. DCS measured as decline slope over day; flatter slope = worse. 12 health outcome subtypes analysed.

risk_of_bias.note: Systematic review rated using AMSTAR-like criteria. Mixed underlying study quality. 91.1% cross-sectional (limits causal inference). High heterogeneity (I²=83.23). Publication bias detected (Egger p=.002) but trim-and-fill suggests minimal impact.

effect_size_notes.overall_health: r=.147 (.112–.183) p<.001 — pooled DCS↔all health outcomes
effect_size_notes.cancer: r=.231 (.113–.343) p<.001 — mapped to overall ER_CORTISOL_HPA (not separate row)
